name: @pipeworx/mcp-dol-m1

tools.name: dol_m1_search
tools.description: Search U.S. DOL Form M-1 filings — the federal report filed by multiple employer welfare arrangements (MEWAs) and association health plans (AHPs) that pool health coverage across unrelated employers. Filter by plan year, MEWA/plan name, sponsor name, EIN, headquarters state, state(s) where the plan offers coverage, filing type, and whether it carries stop-loss coverage or is fully insured. Returns the total match count first, then up to `limit` filings with MEWA name, EIN, headquarters state, plan year, filing date, administrator and sponsor. Complements `form5500` (annual plan financial/participant returns) and `ebsa` (EBSA's own civil-penalty enforcement record) — this is neither of those, it is the MEWA registration/compliance filing itself.

plan_year.description: Plan year of the filing, e.g. 2024. Omit for all years (2003-2025).

mewa_name.description: Name of the MEWA or association health plan. Substring match.

sponsor.description: Name of the plan sponsor. Substring match.

ein.description: MEWA Employer Identification Number (9 digits, dashes optional). Exact match.

hq_state.description: Two-letter state code of the MEWA's headquarters (e.g. "TX").

coverage_state.description: Two-letter state code of a state where the MEWA offers coverage — distinct from hq_state; a MEWA can be headquartered elsewhere and still cover this state.

filing_type.description: Type of Form M-1 filing. Omit for all types.

has_stop_loss.description: Restrict to MEWAs that do (true) or do not (false) carry stop-loss coverage. Omit for either.

fully_insured.description: Restrict to MEWAs that are (true) or are not (false) fully insured. Omit for either.

tools.name: dol_m1_filer
tools.description: Full Form M-1 filing history for one named MEWA or sponsor — every plan year it filed, newest first, plus a count. Matches the name against both the MEWA name and the sponsor name, or pass an exact EIN instead. Use to answer "has this MEWA/association health plan filed Form M-1, and for which years" or "is this plan still registered".

name.description: MEWA or sponsor name, matched as a substring against both fields.

ein.description: MEWA EIN (9 digits, dashes optional), exact match. Provide this or `name`.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-dol-m1 forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the dol-m1 pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
